name: OTEL Trace Delivery
description: Complete flow of trace data from application code through OTEL collector to storage and UI delivery

scenarios.description: Trace successfully flows from app through collector to storage and is delivered to UI

template.introduction:
**Trace Delivered Successfully**

Trace `{{trace.id}}` was created by the application, collected by the OTEL server, stored, and delivered to the UI.

**End-to-End Latency:** ~{{collector.processing_time + storage.write_time + messageport.delivery_time}}ms

events.otel.endpoint.request_received: [2] OTLP endpoint received {{http.method}} request at {{http.url}} on port {{http.port}} (content-type: {{content.type}})
events.otel.collector.trace_received: [3] Collector parsed trace data in {{collector.mode}} mode ({{resource.spans.count}} resource spans, format: {{trace.format}})
events.otel.storage.trace_stored: [4] Trace `{{trace.id}}` stored in buffer at {{storage.timestamp}} ({{storage.size}}/{{storage.max_size}} traces)
events.otel.messageport.trace_routed: [5] Trace routed to window {{window.id}} via MessagePort from {{source.url}} (type: {{message.type}}, port registered: {{port.registered}})
events.otel.preload.port_registered: [7] Preload registered port for window {{window.id}} from {{source.url}} (key: {{port.key}}, {{subscribers.count}} subscribers)
events.otel.systemmonitor.traces_polled: [9] SystemMonitor polled and retrieved {{traces.fetched}} traces (limit: {{traces.limit}}, {{services.count}} services, interval: {{poll.interval_ms}}ms)
